rows.title: Norway EEA Free Movement — Employment Rules 2024
rows.change_summary: Initial UIM regulatory version for Norway EEA employment corridor. Covers police registration, D-number, tax card, bank account, and national registry obligations under the EEA Agreement and Norwegian Immigration Act.
rows.notes: Based on EEA Agreement Article 28 on freedom of movement for workers, the EU/EEA Citizens Directive (2004/38/EC) as implemented in Norway, and Skatteetaten D-number regulations.

rows.title: Germany EU Blue Card Rules 2024
rows.change_summary: Initial UIM regulatory version for Germany EU Blue Card corridor. Placeholder for India→Germany pathway.
rows.notes: Based on German Residence Act (AufenthG) §18b and EU Blue Card Directive 2021/1883.
